gates.condition: Freeze exact case facts, archive, prompts, resource prerequisites, branches, matched output opportunities, call budget and confirmation scope before any future scored call.
Verify actual scored output parent, exact machine condition IDs, fact-reference grammar and named available interpreter before freeze; distinguish method name from condition identity.
Two independent raw reviews cover every proposal and all archive/candidate pairs before summary rewriting; unknown and equivalent remain distinct.
Use genuinely untouched confirmation facts with unchanged rules; do not choose adverse boundaries after observations.
No superiority from invalid delivery; no novelty credit for wording alone; disclose unmatched context and unavailable cost; structural route pass establishes only route structure.

promotion_guardrails: Local archive-relative operational newness does not prove global originality, observed benefit or canonical whole-skill efficacy.
